In September 2025, the Company announced a multi-phase project aimed at upgrading facilities across its Hanover, Pennsylvania campus.
The project includes upgrading the Company's headquarters and transforming it into a modern employee hub as well as other upgrades.

As part of this project during May 2026, the Company sold one property in Hanover, PA for $1.2 million and another property in Hanover, Pennsylvania for $4.2 million during September 2026 that were previously reported in Assets held for sale.
